assertions.name: div25_q_deformation_test_decisive
assertions.source: The probe computes c_3 with /25 (current main) vs the q-deformed candidate /[5]_q², and compares ε_ppm vs the cal-anchored c_3 target. Reports which is closer. Decisive either way.

description: Test the audit-doc conjecture /25 = (T(2,5) framing)². Compares the q-undeformed /25 c_3 closure (current main) to a q-deformed /[5]_q² candidate. If the q-deformation gives a worse c_3 fit, /25 is not a framing² in the categorical sense (it does not deform with q).

candidate_categorical_25_at_q_1.note: All four reduce to 25 at q=1; they DIFFER away from q=1.

verdict.conclusion: /25 in c_3 closure is q-undeformed empirical constant; q-deformation /[5]_q² gives WORSE precision. /25 is NOT a categorical framing² that deforms with q. The structural source remains OPEN (classical-limit framing, integer-denominator Habiro element, or unreduced Markov normalization at 5 strands).

q0AnchorReason: Reads no substrate value. PROVED by running this producer underQOU_Q0_ANCHOR=muon and =proton and diffing the emitted witness:the only non-ephemeral leaves that differ are q0Anchor andq0Value THEMSELVES -- every substantive field is byte-identical,so the pin changes the label and nothing else. Its previous`muon` label was therefore a false claim that this producercomputed at that anchor. `independent` is the honestdisposition; a q0_anchor_manifest entry would be the WRONG fix,promoting a false claim into a declared one.
